expr: (() => { const b = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(x => /sign in|log in|submit/i.test(x.textContent || '')); if (b) { b.click(); return 'clicked login'; } return 'no login button'; })()

(() => { const el = document.querySelector('[aria-label*="unread notification"]'); const t = document.body.innerText; const rows = document.querySelectorAll('[role=button]').length; return 'badge=' + (el ? el.textContent : 'none') + ';feedRows=' + rows + ';fired=' + t.includes('Schedule fired') + ';failed=' + t.includes('Task failed') + ';tabs=' + (t.includes('Feed') && t.includes('Audit log')); })()
(() => { const rows = document.querySelectorAll('[role=button]'); if (!rows.length) return 'no rows'; rows[0].click(); return 'clicked first notification row'; })()

(() => { const rows = document.querySelectorAll('[role=button]'); const r = rows[0]; const dot = r ? r.querySelector('[aria-label=unread]') : null; return 'row1UnreadAfterClick=' + (dot ? 'yes' : 'no') + ';rows=' + rows.length; })()

(() => { const b = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(x => (x.textContent || '').includes('Mark all read')); if (!b) return 'no mark-all button'; b.click(); return 'clicked Mark all read'; })()
(() => { const b = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(x => (x.textContent || '').includes('Audit log')); if (!b) return 'no audit tab'; b.click(); return 'opened audit tab'; })()
